messages:
rachael (PM): quick thought  Can we add named deploy-presets that the bot reads from repo or org settings? repeating flags every time is noisy

ev an (SRE): +1. presets should cover canary profiles, maintenance windows, and a default fallback rule

tom (ENG): I'd prefer: repo-first (.redwood/deploy-presets.yaml) + an override in the Console. Parser should be tiny and forgiving

alex (Release Lead): fallback options I want: revert-to-last-stable, pin-to-tag, or traffic-shift-to-region. auto vs manual must be explicit

kim (QA): also ask: can the bot emit a rollout-preview webhook so tests/QA can run staged smoke suites before each step? would cut surprises

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: idea ack'd. propose CLI: `/deploy --preset=name [--dry-run] [--fallback=manual|revert:<tag>|pin:<tag>]` plus subcommands: `/deploy-presets list|apply|import`

rachael (PM): can we have the preset include a release-note fragment? QA wants a summary of PRs per stage

tom (ENG): example preset:```yaml
# .redwood/deploy-presets.yaml
canary-quick:
  steps:
    - pct: 5
      wait: 60
      smoke: basic
    - pct: 25
      wait: 180
      smoke: full
  fallback: revert-to-last-stable
  notify: ["#eng-oncall","#releases"]
  release_note: "Deploys {{tag}} using canary-quick. PRs: {{prs}}"
```

evan (SRE): implementation notes: the bot should 1) validate preset schema on PR, 2) support a preview webhook that sends the planned steps and target pods, 3) expose "dry-run idempotency" so running dry-run twice is identical

alex (Release Lead): operational flow: run dry-run -> bot posts preview -> QA approves -> run actual deploy -> bot posts per-step status + auto-pause if healthchecks fail. auto-fallback only if explicitly set to auto

kim (QA): test matrix: fail at step 1 (smoke fail), delayed readiness, partial error spikes. ensure bot posts clear rollback instructions and links to original tag

tom (ENG): small CLI UX tweak: `/deploy --preset=canary-quick --confirm` should prompt a one-click confirm in the thread, otherwise require `--confirm=token` for automation

rachael (PM): ok owners? who will draft the tiny RFC and a starter preset file for platform repo?

alex (Release Lead): I'll draft policy (fallback/gating) and sample tags
tom (ENG): I'll add CLI flags + preset parser. will add schema + presubmit linter in a follow up
evan (SRE): I'll build the preview webhook and the healthcheck hook integration. will also add monitoring for "preset drift" between console and repo

kim (QA): I'll author the smoke suites to plug into the webhook and write failure scenarios

rachael (PM): target: RFC PR by Tue, staging prototype mid-sprint. thanks :rocket:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: created issue infra/deploy-presets-v2 and assigned alex,tom,evan,kim,rachael. checklist: schema v1, CLI flags, preview webhook, dry-run idempotency, release-note fragment support.
